verdict.rationale: Claude Code supports persistent context via CLAUDE.md, which is read automatically at the start of every session, giving a form of cross-session recall for coding standards and architecture decisions. However, this file is manually authored/edited by developers, not automatically built or updated by the agent itself, so the 'automatic building' half of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: evidence of the agent autonomously writing/updating memory files from session learnings, and any built-in long-term memory/recall system beyond the static CLAUDE.md.
